archetypes.name: replay-parity
archetypes.rationale: Bonus eligibility must match live attribution arity without changing base scoring.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review classification replay scoring for parity with live unique-finder attribution. Focus on OOS, rejected, neutral, comma-separated, and whitespace co-proposer rows. Check that bonus application is per row, not per reviewer. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: progress-rendering
archetypes.rationale: Progress reports now aggregate fractional reviewer points from replay TSVs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review progress-report Top reviewers integration. Verify fractional aggregation, integer formatting, label-map behavior, and fallback behavior when classification TSVs are absent or lack known labels. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
